guide.summary: Forgejo documents OAuth2 for third-party apps with user consent. Prepare a test-instance app registration, implement the redirect and token exchange, then authorize a representative test account. OAuth scopes are not implemented and tokens carry administrative rights, so read-only behavior must be enforced in app code. The repository-list endpoint and pagination parameters are not in the supplied sources, so the action test is blocked. Provider review and distribution requirements are unknown.
guide.recommendation: The requested API test is not ready yet. Resolve the access mapping for List repository names visible to the connected person, with pagination. Use “Find missing request” or add official documentation beside that action.
guide.nextAction: Register a test OAuth application on the test Forgejo instance

findings.title: OAuth2 provider is documented for third-party apps
findings.detail: Forgejo can act as an OAuth2 provider so third-party apps can access resources with the user's consent.

evidence.quote: OAuth2 provider Forgejo supports acting as an OAuth2 provider to allow third party applications to access its resources with the user’s consent.

findings.title: Each customer instance needs an app registered by its administrator
findings.detail: Instance-wide OAuth2 applications are created on the /admin/applications page of that instance.
findings.appliesWhen: Each customer-operated Forgejo instance the app connects to.

evidence.quote: Forgejo can act as an instance-wide OAuth2 provider. To achieve that, OAuth2 applications must be created on the /admin/applications page.

findings.title: Authorization, token and userinfo endpoints
findings.detail: Authorize at /login/oauth/authorize, exchange the code at /login/oauth/access_token, and read identity at /login/oauth/userinfo. The example token response shows expires_in 3600.

evidence.quote: Authorization Endpoint /login/oauth/authorize Access Token Endpoint /login/oauth/access_token
OpenID Connect UserInfo /login/oauth/userinfo
"expires_in" : 3600 ,

findings.title: OAuth2 scopes are not implemented
findings.detail: Forgejo does not implement OAuth2 scopes, so the read-only limit cannot be selected as an OAuth grant. Scoped personal tokens are a different mechanism.

evidence.quote: OAuth2 scopes are not yet implemented.
Note Scoped tokens or personal access tokens are entirely different from OAuth2;

findings.title: OAuth tokens carry administrative rights
findings.detail: Third-party apps that obtain a user token through an OAuth2 app have administrative rights. Read-only behavior must therefore come from the app's own code.

evidence.quote: Note Third-party applications obtaining a token for a user via such an application will have administrative rights.

steps.title: Register a test OAuth application on the test Forgejo instance
steps.detail: Create an OAuth2 application on /admin/applications of the test instance. Save the client ID and client secret, because the secret is shown only once.
steps.doneWhen: The application appears on the admin applications page and the client ID and secret are saved securely.

evidence.quote: Forgejo can act as an instance-wide OAuth2 provider. To achieve that, OAuth2 applications must be created on the /admin/applications page.
The CLIENT_SECRET is the unique secret code generated for this application. Please note that the secret will only be visible after you created/registered the application with Forgejo and cannot be

steps.appliesWhen: A test instance where the developer has administrator access.

steps.title: Implement authorization redirect, callback and code exchange
steps.detail: Redirect to /login/oauth/authorize with client_id, redirect_uri, response_type=code and state. The callback posts the returned code to /login/oauth/access_token with grant_type authorization_code. The REDIRECT_URI must match in both requests.
steps.doneWhen: The authorize URL and token request are built with the same REDIRECT_URI, and the callback handles the returned code.

evidence.quote: Redirect the user to the authorization endpoint in order to get their consent for accessing the resources:

https://[ REDIRECT_URI ]?code=RETURNED_CODE&state=STATE Using the provided code from the redirect, you can request a new application and refresh token. The access token endpoint accepts POST requests with application/json and
POST https://[YOUR-FORGEJO-URL]/login/oauth/access_token { "client_id" : "YOUR_CLIENT_ID" ,
The REDIRECT_URI in the access_token request must match the REDIRECT_URI in the authorize request.

steps.title: Authorize a representative test account and exchange the code
steps.detail: Sign in a representative test account on the test instance, approve the app, and exchange the returned code. Call /login/oauth/userinfo with the bearer token to confirm the account. This is a token check, not a repository test.
steps.doneWhen: A bearer access_token and refresh_token are received, and userinfo returns the test account identity.

evidence.quote: The user will now be asked to authorize your application. If they authorize it, the user will be redirected to the REDIRECT_URL , for example:

Response: { "access_token" : "eyJhbGciOiJIUzUxMiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJnbnQiOjIsInR0IjowLCJleHAiOjE1NTUxNzk5MTIsImlhdCI6MTU1NTE3NjMxMn0.0-iFsAwBtxuckA0sNZ6QpBQmywVPz129u75vOM7wPJecw5wqGyBkmstfJHAjEOqrAf_V5Z-1QYeCh_Cz4RiKug" ,
Use the access_token to make API requests to access the user’s resources.
OpenID Connect UserInfo /login/oauth/userinfo

steps.title: Confirm a documented read-only repository listing endpoint
steps.detail: The supplied documentation does not define a request for listing visible repositories. No curl command, endpoint, or pagination example can be given from it. Token scopes are grouped by API route. The read scope covers GET routes only. A read-only listing needs a documented repository GET route and its matching read scope. OAuth2 scopes are not implemented. Third-party applications receiving a token through this flow have administrative rights. Excluded: create, edit, and delete repository permissions and write scopes. Once a listing route is documented, use one representative GET with a small page size and expect a successful response containing repository names. Boundary check: confirm no write effects occur and that a page beyond the last returns an empty list.
steps.doneWhen: Supplied documentation contains a GET repository listing endpoint with documented pagination parameters and a read scope that maps to it, and the request is then validated against that route.

evidence.quote: read : GET routes
OAuth2 scopes are not yet implemented.
Only the read:repository , write:repository , read:issue , and write:issue permissions can be used for a specific repository access token. Other scopes are not permitted because the API would not

steps.doneWhen: A code search or review records no write-method calls for the repository-listing feature.

evidence.quote: Note Third-party applications obtaining a token for a user via such an application will have administrative rights.

preparation.title: Registration worksheet
preparation.text:
Register a test OAuth application on the test Forgejo instance
Create an OAuth2 application on /admin/applications of the test instance. Save the client ID and client secret, because the secret is shown only once.
Fields: Application name, Redirect URI, CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_SECRET

Implement authorization redirect, callback and code exchange
Redirect to /login/oauth/authorize with client_id, redirect_uri, response_type=code and state. The callback posts the returned code to /login/oauth/access_token with grant_type authorization_code. The REDIRECT_URI must match in both requests.
Fields: INSTANCE_BASE_URL, CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_SECRET, REDIRECT_URI

preparation.title: First connection test
preparation.text:
Authorize a representative test account and exchange the code
Done when: A bearer access_token and refresh_token are received, and userinfo returns the test account identity.

Confirm a documented read-only repository listing endpoint
Done when: Supplied documentation contains a GET repository listing endpoint with documented pagination parameters and a read scope that maps to it, and the request is then validated against that route.

Confirm the app sends only GET requests for this feature
Done when: A code search or review records no write-method calls for the repository-listing feature.
